# Tree

Tree presents hierarchical data with disclosure, selection, keyboard navigation, optional counts, metadata, and safe nested row actions. Use `TreeParentItemRow` and `TreeChildItemRow` when product screens need to compose custom trees from reusable parent and terminal row primitives.

- **Import:** `import { Tree, TreeChildItemRow, TreeItemRow, TreeParentItemRow } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/data-display-tree--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider, Tree, type TreeItem } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

const sampleData: TreeItem[] = [
  {
    id: "1",
    name: "src",
    children: [
      {
        id: "2",
        name: "components",
        children: [
          { id: "3", name: "Button.tsx" },
          { id: "4", name: "Input.tsx" },
        ],
      },
      { id: "5", name: "App.tsx" },
      { id: "6", name: "index.tsx" },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: "7",
    name: "package.json",
  },
];

export function TreeExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Tree data={sampleData} />
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Tree

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `TreeProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "onSelect">`.

- `data`: `TreeItem[]`, optional, default `[]`.
- `children`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `ariaLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Tree"`.
- `density`: `TreeDensity`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `indent`: `number`, optional, default `20`.
- `activationMode`: `TreeActivationMode`, optional, default `"select-toggle"`.
- `defaultExpandedIds`: `string[]`, optional, default `[]`.
- `expandedIds`: `string[]`, optional.
- `onExpandedChange`: `(ids: string[]) => void`, optional.
- `defaultSelectedId`: `string`, optional.
- `selectedId`: `string`, optional.
- `onSelectionChange`: `(item: TreeItem) => void`, optional.
- `renderIcon`: `(context: TreeItemRenderContext) => React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `renderMeta`: `(context: TreeItemRenderContext) => React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `renderActions`: `(context: TreeItemRenderContext) => React.ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## TreeChildItemRow

A row with no children: a treeitem with no disclosure and no
`aria-expanded`.

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `TreeChildItemRowProps`, which is `Omit<TreeItemRowProps, "hasChildren" | "expanded">`.

- `meta`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `disabled`: `boolean`, optional.

  Dims the row, and is its `aria-disabled`.

- `name`: `React.ReactNode`, **required**.
- `actions`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `actionsVisibility`: `"auto" | "always"`, optional.
- `count`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `density`: `TreeDensity`, optional.
- `depth`: `number`, optional.

  How deep the row is, 0 at the top: its indent, and its `aria-level`, one more.

- `focusVisible`: `boolean`, optional.
- `icon`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `indent`: `number`, optional.
- `onDisclosureClick`: `(event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLSpanElement>) => void`, optional.
- `selected`: `boolean`, optional.

  Its `aria-selected`, and the selected fill.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## TreeItemRow

One row of a tree, and its treeitem: `depth` gives its `aria-level`,
`expanded` its `aria-expanded` when it has children, `selected` its
`aria-selected` and `disabled` its `aria-disabled`.

Tree draws these rows itself from `data`. To compose a tree, put the rows
in a `Tree` with children, which is the `role="tree"` container, and a
parent's children in a `<div role="group">` right after its row. A composed
tree has no keyboard of its own: Tree moves focus with the arrow keys only
through `data`.

A caller's own `role` or `aria-*` wins. With another role, such as `"none"`
inside a treeitem of the caller's own, the row adds no tree state.

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `TreeItemRowProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.

- `name`: `React.ReactNode`, **required**.
- `actions`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `actionsVisibility`: `"auto" | "always"`, optional, default `"auto"`.
- `count`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `density`: `TreeDensity`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `depth`: `number`, optional, default `0`.

  How deep the row is, 0 at the top: its indent, and its `aria-level`, one more.

- `disabled`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.

  Dims the row, and is its `aria-disabled`.

- `expanded`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.

  Whether a row with children shows them: its `aria-expanded`.

- `focusVisible`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.
- `hasChildren`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.

  Draws the disclosure, and gives the row `aria-expanded`.

- `icon`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `indent`: `number`, optional, default `20`.
- `meta`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `onDisclosureClick`: `(event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLSpanElement>) => void`, optional.
- `selected`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.

  Its `aria-selected`, and the selected fill.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## TreeParentItemRow

A row with children, as `TreeItemRow` with `hasChildren`: a treeitem whose
`expanded` is its `aria-expanded`. When it is expanded, put its children in
a `<div role="group">` right after it, at `depth` one more.

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `TreeParentItemRowProps`, which is `Omit<TreeItemRowProps, "hasChildren">`.

- `meta`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `disabled`: `boolean`, optional.

  Dims the row, and is its `aria-disabled`.

- `name`: `React.ReactNode`, **required**.
- `expanded`: `boolean`, optional.

  Whether a row with children shows them: its `aria-expanded`.

- `actions`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `actionsVisibility`: `"auto" | "always"`, optional.
- `count`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `density`: `TreeDensity`, optional.
- `depth`: `number`, optional.

  How deep the row is, 0 at the top: its indent, and its `aria-level`, one more.

- `focusVisible`: `boolean`, optional.
- `icon`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `indent`: `number`, optional.
- `onDisclosureClick`: `(event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLSpanElement>) => void`, optional.
- `selected`: `boolean`, optional.

  Its `aria-selected`, and the selected fill.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### TreeItem

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
interface TreeItem {
  id: string;
  name: React.ReactNode;
  children?: TreeItem[];
  disabled?: boolean;
  icon?: TreeItemSlot;
  count?: TreeItemSlot;
  meta?: TreeItemSlot;
  actions?: TreeItemSlot;
  className?: string;
}
```

### TreeDensity

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type TreeDensity = "default" | "compact";
```

### TreeActivationMode

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type TreeActivationMode = "select" | "toggle" | "select-toggle";
```

### TreeItemRenderContext

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
interface TreeItemRenderContext {
  item: TreeItem;
  depth: number;
  hasChildren: boolean;
  expanded: boolean;
  selected: boolean;
  focused: boolean;
  disabled: boolean;
  toggle: (force?: boolean) => void;
  select: () => void;
}
```

### TreeItemSlot

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type TreeItemSlot =
  | React.ReactNode
  | ((context: TreeItemRenderContext) => React.ReactNode);
```
